method: Rule-assisted draft from source question text and existing endpoint reviews, with explicit question-level overrides. Skill labels are provisional; source instructions and reframing contracts are exposed for review. No source answers or fixtures are published.
eligibility_policy: Include source tasks whose scientific purpose admits a clear executable framing, even when the original scorer is an LLM. Freeze missing conventions or scope narrative interpretation to computed evidence. Exclude a replacement objective, unavailable source instruction or unbounded subjective synthesis.
counting: Count each eligible question once per skill. Source questions, shared study/protocol groups, workflow proposals and validated authored tasks remain separate quantities. These counts do not measure model competence.
